name: Smith's Tools
operation_language: Authoring intent only; not registered engine syntax.

rules.text: Ability: strength. Utilize: Pry open a door or container (DC 20). Craft: Any Melee weapon except Club, Greatclub, Quarterstaff and Whip; Medium armor except Hide; Heavy armor; Ball Bearings, Bucket, Caltrops, Chain, Crowbar, Firearm Bullets, Grappling Hook, Iron Pot, Iron Spikes, Sling Bullets. Tool proficiency adds PB to ability checks using the tool; if also proficient in a skill used with the check, gain Advantage. Each Artisan tool needs its own proficiency.
